questions: What indirect path, if any, reads the r_cloth ConVar value after registration?
What exact lifecycle event destroys a StudioRender cloth handle rather than resetting it?

findings.fact: engine.dll registers r_cloth and the cloth_reset command.
findings.evidence: r_cloth registration 0x200a5cb0; cloth_reset registration 0x200a84c0 and help string 'resets all cloth in the world'.
findings.consequence: Retail exposes a cloth control surface, but registration alone does not establish the exact r_cloth gate.

findings.fact: 0x200a5ce0 is the static r_cloth ConVar destructor, not a value-change callback.
findings.evidence: The thunk loads ECX=0x20d63b88 and jumps to the common ConVar destructor 0x200405f0; its sole xref is static registration cleanup.
findings.consequence: Do not infer renderer state changes from this function; r_cloth's exact runtime consumer remains open.

findings.fact: VEngineModel006 creates a StudioRender cloth-instance handle only when runtime MDLHeader.Flags has bit 0x400.
findings.evidence: 0x200a7be0 tests studio header +0xe4 & 0x400 and calls TStudioRender012 slot +0x98; the returned 16-bit handle is retained by the engine model instance.
findings.consequence: The installed header flag is the engine-side authored garment-cloth gate.

findings.fact: cloth_reset walks live engine model instances and resets their StudioRender cloth handles.
findings.evidence: 0x200a84f0 reaches the live-instance walk at 0x200a8480, which forwards each valid handle to TStudioRender012 slot +0xa0.
findings.consequence: Persistent simulation state is instance-owned and can be forced to lazy reinitialization without reloading the model.

findings.fact: VEngineModel006 slot +0x68 forwards wind and dynamic collision inputs to TStudioRender012 slot +0xa4.
findings.consequence: Client entity wind and player collision cross the engine/renderer boundary through an explicit cloth method.

functions.label: register_r_cloth
functions.role: Constructs the r_cloth ConVar object at 0x20d63b88.

functions.label: destroy_r_cloth
functions.role: Static ConVar destructor thunk; not a change callback.

functions.label: create_model_instance
functions.role: Tests MDLHeader.Flags 0x400 and creates the StudioRender cloth handle.

functions.label: reset_model_instance_cloth
functions.role: Forwards a live engine model instance's cloth handle to StudioRender reset.

functions.label: cloth_reset_command
functions.role: Command callback that walks every live engine model instance.

functions.label: submit_cloth_environment
functions.role: VEngineModel006 slot +0x68 forwarding wind and dynamic collision records.
